_comment: (spec §5.5 the anchor-stone-per-region idiom -- the #10/#12/#16 contract) Each row is one fast-travel DESTINATION: {id, display_name, map, cell, requires_accomplishment, arrival_toast}. `requires_accomplishment` gates the row at >= 1 (the door_when/contains_when >= semantics); a future region milestone appends a row keyed on ITS OWN attunement accomplishment, zero code (src/core/portals.gd's WIPortals.attuned_destinations/build_portal_graph read this list generically). v1 ships the Liscor pair: the inn's pantry_door <-> the street's street_anchor_stone, both gated on door_awakened (they attune together -- the SAME beat-4 awakening opens both ends of the player's own home-region connection). Arrival cells are blast-radius-checked walkable + off every canonical route (the DP3 discipline): inn (9,6) is the D1-confirmed free interior cell immediately west of pantry_door (10,6); street (29,10) is the open mid-street cell immediately west of the new street_anchor_stone (30,10), clear of every blocked/decor/entity cell on that map.

portals.arrival_toast: Cold light, gone as fast as it came. The gate district's noise rushes back in around you.
Warm air, woodsmoke, the creak of the pantry door settling shut behind you. You're back, and you didn't walk here.
The light warms and the air smells of wheat and river water before you've taken a step. Riverfarm, same as the rumor said.
portals._comment: 8b R1 (issue #10) -- the anchor-stone-per-region idiom's first genuinely NEW instance (zero code, per this file's own top-level comment). riverfarm_attuned banks from the Guild-board rumor beat (a rumor-flagged bounties.json posting, read at THE REQUEST BOARD), not from any door-awakening beat -- a new region earns its OWN attunement, distinct from the Liscor pair's shared door_awakened. Arrival cell (13,5) sits one cell east of riverfarm_anchor_stone (12,5) at the village's own end of the pair, open + off every blocked/decor/entity cell on that map (blast-radius checked).
